create.name: Preethaji
create.bio:
Preethaji, born Preetha Krishna, is an Indian teacher of meditation and philosophy who works alongside her husband, Krishnaji. Before turning to teaching full time she studied business administration, and in 2002 she started a women's initiative in Bangalore. In 2009 the couple opened One World Academy in Kanchipuram, a school for philosophy and meditation that was later renamed O&O Academy, and together they lead Ekam, a large meditation centre in rural Andhra Pradesh that hosts an annual world peace festival.

The idea at the centre of her teaching is the contrast between a 'suffering state' and a 'beautiful state': learning to notice self-absorbed patterns of thought and to shift into calm, connected awareness. She teaches short guided practices such as Soul Sync and the Serene Mind Practice, gives talks on consciousness, relationships and conscious leadership, and leads online journeys and residential programmes. With Krishnaji she wrote The Four Sacred Secrets, published in 2019. She has spoken at TEDx events in Kansas City and Shanghai, taught at Omega Institute, and offers a ten-day course on Commune.

books.title: The Four Sacred Secrets: For Love and Prosperity, A Guide to Living in a Beautiful State
books.author: Preethaji and Krishnaji
books.description: Co-written with Krishnaji, the book lays out four principles for moving from inner conflict to a calm, connected way of living. Each chapter mixes stories from their students with short meditations and reflective exercises.

courses.title: Live in a Beautiful State
courses.description: A ten-day video course on Commune drawn from the teaching of O&O Academy. Each day pairs a short talk on philosophy with a guided meditation that can be repeated, and audio versions and transcripts are included.

courses.title: Oneness Manifest (Online Experience)
courses.description: A year-long online programme with one live session a month guided by Preethaji, each focused on a different inner quality, plus weekly group practice sessions. It can be joined monthly, for six months or for a year.

courses.title: Tapas at Ekam 2027
courses.description: A residential programme at Ekam in Andhra Pradesh, guided by Preethaji and Krishnaji, offered as four week-long stages that can be joined singly or back to back. Days combine talks, group meditation and contemplative processes.

sprint.tier_evidence: Her public accounts are joint with Krishnaji: Instagram @theonenessmovement ('Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji') 104K (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); YouTube @theonenessmovement ('Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji') 94K (channel header row, 31 Oct 2026); Facebook /theonenessmovement not readable. Shared accounts are not counted for a solo listing, so her own readable total is ~0 (Instagram @preethaji, 1,401 followers and 0 posts, is not clearly hers and is not counted). Joint total ~198k if the listing were the couple → luminary.
sprint.tier_override: Editorial stature: co-author of The Four Sacred Secrets (Atria/Simon & Schuster, 2019, a US national bestseller per Ekam) and co-founder of O&O Academy and Ekam; the joint accounts she fronts total ~198k.
flags: Possible couple listing: almost all her public material is joint with her husband Krishnaji (the book, the YouTube and Instagram accounts named 'Sri Preethaji & Sri Krishnaji', Ekam and the Tapas retreat). Made as one listing for her as asked; the owner may prefer 'Preethaji and Krishnaji' as a couple listing.

Ekam and its accounts belong to the Oneness Movement. They present Krishnaji's late father, Kalki Bhagavan (described by Wikipedia's sources as a 'self-styled godman'), as divine: a recent video says he 'himself will come to receive your offering'. They also offer 'Deeksha' energy transmissions and 'Divine Miracles'. This is not conspiracy content, but a human should decide whether it fits.

Wikipedia notes a 2019 Income Tax Department raid and order against her, later quashed by the Madras High Court (2020; the department's appeal was dismissed in 2022). It also lists business directorships (Kosmik Global Media, owner of the Bengaluru Bulls kabaddi team).

The Commune course page's tagline is 'Walk out of anxiety, loneliness, and stress', and two of its ten days are titled around anxiety and stress. The title and my description name no condition, so it is kept; borderline, check.

No published email: Ekam's site shows only a phone number and a contact form (ekam.org/contact), which is an organisation form, not hers personally. The O&O Academy site (oo.academy) could not be read because its TLS certificate has expired, and preethaji.com did not respond.
City set to Varadaiahpalem (Ekam's village in Chittoor district, Andhra Pradesh; the site spells it 'Varadiapalem'); she also teaches internationally.
Has a teacher page at Omega (eomega.org/workshops/teachers/preethaji) but is not in omega-institute-faculty.json, so Omega is not added to teaches_at.
All YouTube videos except the Commune one are on the joint Oneness Movement channel; a few are joint talks, and the guided meditations (Soul Sync, Serene Mind) are led by her.
Second photo is a Commune course still; the first is the Omega headshot. Both clearly show the same person.
left_out: Ekam's Shathayu longevity retreat and Oneness Ayurveda wellness: health-framed.
Guru Darshan (20 Dec 2026): a darshan with Krishnaji, not her teaching.
Oneness Abundance Festival (Mumbai): no date or price found on the pages read.
Ekam 9-Minute Blessing, annadanam appeals and Kalki Bhagavan content: devotional, and not her teaching.
Videos on 'karmic healing', 'emotional wounds' and the stress and anxiety clip ('What you must know if you want to be free of stress & anxiety'): healing or condition framing.
Earlier book Freedom in Relationships (2013): no amazon.com listing checked or found.
Manifest and Tapas prices appear only in the booking flow, so both are listed as 'Contact for pricing'.
The Breathing Room app and Soul Sync clusters are run by Ekam, not her personally; not listed as free resources.
